ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's child care programs and follow the money to determine who is behind the scheme and how much money is involved.
questions: Who is behind the alleged fraud in Minnesota's child care programs?
How much money is involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and investigating the alleged fraud, we may be able to identify a larger pattern of corruption and abuse.
